results.notes: The listing is out of date in several ways. (1) Deadline: the listing's Jan 22, 2026 has passed. The sponsor's 2027-28 cycle full application deadline is April 9, 2027 (added year is from the page, which gives the full date). Before that, a one-page letter of intent is due Feb. 6, 2027, and applicants are notified by Feb. 17, 2027 if invited to submit a full application; the full-application deadline is the one listed as the value. (2) Amount: the listing says up to $22,500; the sponsor's page says the cost-of-living allowance will not exceed $15,200 USD, so the sponsor figure is used. (3) Sponsor naming: the page is hosted by UC San Diego's Center for U.S.-Mexican Studies (USMEX) at the School of Global Policy and Strategy, not the School of International Relations and Pacific Studies listed as agency2; the page does not mention IR/PS. (4) Eligibility: the sponsor also says postdocs are generally not accepted, and that residential periods run three to nine months with starts in October or January. Non-resident fellowships are by invitation only and get no cost-of-living allowance. The listing's 'Fall' season is consistent with an October start but the page does not use that label. Listing's officialUrl (fellows index) is valid.
